Before replying, I checked that Marcus is a member of #north-team, then read the channel. Nothing posted since Ilse's message changes the date. I only looked at #north-team, not the account's files.

**Stray message in the channel:** after my thread reply to Ilse on 14 October, a second message from me appeared at the top level of #north-team. It was my summary of that task, which was meant for you, not the channel. It contains nothing sensitive, but it's clutter you may want to remove.
